answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. Each epoch, random pairs check each other's work history; a shared fingerprint, like boats at one jetty, proves common control and both bonds are slashed. Honest records stay distinct, like an opal's color play. Forging 100 identities costs 100 distinct histories plus 150 credits each, 15,000 total, above the split reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards over a long horizon.
